🛠️ GTA 6 Gets Its First Major Patch

Rockstar has rolled out Grand Theft Auto 6's first post-launch update, tackling one of the most-reported issues since launch: broken autosaving.

📋 What's fixed (per Video Games Chronicle):
• Autosave not triggering correctly — the bug that cost some players their progress
• Several crashes
• Weather getting stuck for extended periods
• Phone calls (including story-critical ones) failing to trigger
• Being unable to lose your Wanted Level
• The Gym's deadlift bar not working
• Partners not handing over bags to sell to fences

📦 Update size: ~603MB (version 01.002.002) — live now on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

🕒 Published: 12:02 GMT+3, Nov 24 2026

📰 Sources: Video Games Chronicle — https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/grand-theft-auto-6-has-received-a-new-patch-which-fixes-autosaving/
👥 x.com/RockstarGames
